name: sprout-payroll
description: Work with Sprout payroll — one-time external adjustments, overtime rates, payroll runs, approved payroll per employee, and report downloads (payroll summary, payslip PDF, BIR Form 2316).

connection.instructions:
Connect with your **Sprout Payroll (PR) API** credential pair — NOT the HR API pair. Sprout issues two separate credential pairs when granting API access: an **HR API** pair (long 64-character hex strings, used by the Sprout HR/Employee/Time & Attendance plugins) and a **PR API** pair (a short client id that matches your payroll company code, plus a secret). Only the PR pair works here — the HR pair is rejected with `invalid_client`.

1. Request API access from the **Sprout Developer Portal** (Getting Started → Authorization).
2. From the credentials Sprout sends, copy the **PR API** Client ID and Client Secret below.
3. Paste the **Subscription Key** (`Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key`) — required for production access; it is shared across Sprout's HR and Payroll APIs.

We exchange your credentials for a short-lived token automatically — you never paste a bearer token.

fields.name: SPROUT_CLIENT_ID
fields.label: Payroll API Client ID
fields.placeholder: short payroll client id (matches your payroll company code)
fields.helpText: The SHORT Payroll (PR) API client id — not the long hex HR API id.

fields.name: SPROUT_CLIENT_SECRET
fields.label: Payroll API Client Secret
fields.helpText: Issued alongside the Payroll API Client ID. Stored encrypted; exchanged server-side for a token.

fields.name: SPROUT_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY
fields.label: Subscription Key
fields.helpText: Required for production (shared across Sprout's HR and Payroll APIs). Leave blank only for Sprout's sandbox.

fields.name: SPROUT_TENANT_CODE
fields.label: Tenant Code
fields.helpText: Identifies which company the calls target. Leave blank if your client is single-tenant.
